non_claims: This corpus contains synthetic reference models and invented indicator values; it is not a Jukskei ecosystem assessment.
A qualified synthetic reference record does not establish that any real reference site is intact or appropriate.
The corpus does not validate field calibration, biodiversity status, climate projections or restoration effects.
The six ecological attributes are not collapsed into a universal scalar score.

hard_invariants: A recovery claim is specific to the ecosystem, reference-model version, site strata and observation window.
